in_hebrew.name: Ardussi
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Ardussi הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word ‘ardous’, meaning ‘mountainous’, ‘arduous’, ‘ardent’, ‘strong’, and ‘valiant’. This name was borne by Saint Ardusius, a bishop of Cologne during the 13th century.
